answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 20162 Country: India Title: I have been blessed with a daughter. I am looking for some names. One name came to my mind Urooj fatima. Urooj is male name. So this name Uroj fatima is suitable for a girl or not? Question: Assalamo alaikum! I have been blessed with a daughter. I am looking for some names. One name came to my mind Urooj fatima. Urooj is male name. So this name Uroj fatima is suitable for a girl or not? Answer ID: 20162 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 417/287/L=1431) You can keep her name "Uroj Fatima". However, you would better name her only Fatimah and drop Uroj. Fatima is the name of the beloved daughter of holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
